purpose: Authoritative corrected leave-HLA-out gate: does the widened H4 (presentation controlled by antigen-processing MACHINERY STATE) generalize across HLA backgrounds, scored on GENUINE HLA-I LIGANDS so acid-elution (MHC1-TIP) and antibody-IP deposits are comparable.

fixes_applied.fix1_TAPBPR_mislabel: HeLa (PXD078020) KO is TAPBPR (gene TAPBPL, a peptide EDITOR), NOT TAPBP (tapasin, a hard essential). Severity set to editor-class 0.20 (was mislabeled 0.80). Condition relabeled TAPBPR.
fixes_applied.fix2_disjoint_allele_parser: hla_overlap_leakage tokenizer now splits genotypes on [;,\s] (was ',' only, which left ';'-separated strings as one glued token that never matched -> always reported 'disjoint'). Added 1-field group normalization so 'A*02' matches 'A*02:01'. Now correctly detects that A375/THP-1/HeLa all share HLA-A*02.
fixes_applied.fix3_ligand_stratified_retention: ALL 4 backgrounds re-scored on genuine-HLA-I-ligand retention = |{8-11mer KO peptides that are exact anchor ligands of THIS background's HLA-I alleles}| / |{same for WT}|, using the 202-allele mono-allelic anchor (combined_monoallelic_hlaI_human.tsv). This is the A375_B2M_KO_DIAGNOSTIC method that turned A375 B2M-KO from 0.878 (total-peptide) -> ~0.12-0.19 (ligand). It removes the mild-acid-elution non-HLA background that inflated MAE deposits and makes them comparable to W6/32-IP deposits (HAP1).

per_background_ligand_stratified_KO_rete._measure: ligand_ret = anchor-matched-8to11mer(KO) / anchor-matched-8to11mer(WT); total_ret shown for contrast

HAP1_PXD056426_W632_IP.note: H4 holds within HAP1 on the ligand measure (severity predicts ligand loss, rho=0.87). Ligand-ret slightly HIGHER than total-ret because W6/32 IP is already ligand-pure; anchor-matched ligands are more robustly re-detected.

B2M.reconciliation: total-peptide 88% RETAINED collapses to ~19% on genuine HLA-I ligands -> AGREES with HAP1 B2M (9% ligand). The 88% was a mild-acid-elution non-HLA background artifact (see A375_B2M_KO_DIAGNOSTIC.json).

TAPBPR.note: peptide EDITOR KO broadens/retains repertoire (>=100%), expected opposite-of-loss; correctly low severity now.

leave_HLA_out_folds.note: SIGN FLIPPED positive (was -0.9203). Trained on A375+THP-1+HeLa ligand-losses, the fitted slope is now POSITIVE (higher machinery severity -> more ligand loss), so predicting HAP1's severity->loss ordering transfers strongly.

disjoint_allele_check.note: Parser now works. HAP1 (A*03:01/B*51:01/C*01:02) is fully disjoint from the 3 public backgrounds, but A375/THP-1/HeLa are NOT disjoint from each other (all carry HLA-A*02). Disjoint-across-ALL-folds PASS criterion NOT met.

no_A375_sensitivity.note: Even excluding A375, sign stays positive and significant -> the corrected positive transfer is NOT an A375 artifact either.

PASS_FAIL_vs_rule.rule: PASS requires ALL of: pooled transfer rho>=0.30 AND perm p<=0.05 AND >=3 backgrounds each carry positive ordering (transfer>=0.3/fold) AND disjoint HLA alleles across folds.

>=3_backgrounds_carry_ordering.why: only HAP1 has >=3 KO conditions -> only 1 computable fold; the 3 public backgrounds have 1-2 KOs each

PASS_FAIL_vs_rule.verdict_change: Was 'FAIL / ACTIVELY CONTRADICTED (rho=-0.93)'. Corrected to 'UNPROVEN / UNDER-POWERED (rho=+0.68, p=0.0003)'. The two effect-size/significance criteria now PASS; the two structural criteria (>=3 informative backgrounds, disjoint alleles) still fail.

interpretation.sign_flip_confirmed: YES. Corrected pooled transfer rho = +0.6792 (p=0.0003), up from -0.9312 (p=0.883). The negative sign in the original result was an artifact of (a) the TAPBPR->TAPBP mislabel inverting the training slope and (b) scoring MAE deposits on total-peptide retention (non-HLA background) instead of genuine HLA-I ligands.
interpretation.hard_essentials_agree_on_collapse: YES. On the ligand measure, the two independent B2M-KO replicates AGREE: HAP1 B2M 0.09, A375 B2M 0.19 (both collapse). The ERAP1 trimmer KOs (A375 0.94, THP-1 1.00) and the TAPBPR editor KO (HeLa 1.06) correctly show no collapse. H4's machinery->presentation ordering now transfers to the held-out HAP1 background (rho +0.87).
interpretation.still_unproven_because: The gate remains structurally under-powered: only HAP1 carries >=3 KO conditions, so only ONE fold is informative (the 'pooled' statistic is effectively 'can the public backgrounds predict HAP1'). And the public backgrounds are NOT allele-disjoint (all HLA-A*02), so a passing transfer could partly ride on shared-A*02 processing rather than pure machinery generalization. Two independent hard-essential collapses (HAP1 + A375 B2M) is corroborating but does not meet the >=3-disjoint-background bar.

CRO_sizing_implication.verdict_for_CRO: UNPROVEN -> the CRO is still needed, but the framing changes from 'the thesis is contradicted, must re-establish it' to 'the thesis is CORROBORATED on 2 backgrounds but not yet PROVEN cross-allele; fill the disjoint-background gap'.
CRO_sizing_implication.what_is_now_established: B2M-KO collapses genuine HLA-I ligand presentation in TWO independent HLA backgrounds (HAP1 A*03:01/B*51:01/C*01:02 via IP; A375 A*01/A*02/B*44/B*57 via MAE, re-scored on ligands). H4 holds within HAP1 across the full 11-KO severity gradient (rho 0.87) and transfers positively to it.
CRO_sizing_implication.what_the_CRO_must_still_supply: The disjoint-allele-coverage requirement HOLDS. Need >=3 DISTINCT, ALLELE-DISJOINT HLA backgrounds each carrying the HARD-ESSENTIAL machinery-KO panel (B2M, TAP1, TAP2, TAPBP) with >=3 KO conditions per background, same-flask matched proteome, and W6/32-IP (or ligand-validated) enrichment (NOT bare MAE). The current public corpus gives only 1 background (HAP1) with the full essential panel; the others contribute 1-2 trimmer/editor KOs and share A*02.
CRO_sizing_implication.priority: Because the load-bearing A375 anomaly is now RESOLVED (method+measure artifact, not biology), the CRO priority shifts from 'diagnose the discordance' to 'establish >=3 disjoint hard-essential backgrounds' - a cleaner, still-expensive path. Use W6/32-IP enrichment or always ligand-stratify to avoid the MAE background confound.

caveats: Ligand set = EXACT-match to a finite 202-allele mono-allelic anchor -> conservative lower bound on ligand count; true binders absent from the anchor are miscounted as background symmetrically in WT and KO, so the retention RATIO is robust (the A375 88%->19% and HAP1 3%->9% shifts, and the +0.87 HAP1 transfer, do not depend on anchor completeness).

HeLa alleles are 1-field-typed (A*02/B*35/B*08); the anchor union expands each to all 2-field members -> broader ligand set, but HeLa is an editor-KO fold that does not drive the essential-collapse signal.
Only HAP1 has >=3 KOs -> 1 informative fold. The pooled statistic and its null are a single-fold sign test blurred by 4 minority points. A real >=3-background PASS still requires new data.
A375 is cross-method merged (MHC1-TIP/MAE B2M + DIA-NN ERAP1); ligand-stratification mitigates the method difference but per-deposit WT baselines still differ.

No NetMHCpan/MHCflurry affinity prediction run; exact anchor-overlap used (as in the diagnostic). A predicted-affinity re-score would refine but is very unlikely to overturn a 4-5x anchor-hit drop on B2M-KO.
